name: mcp2repl
description: Turn any stdio MCP server into a persistent JavaScript REPL with a single eval surface.

scripts.smoke: node ./src/cli.js --mock --eval "var x = 40; x + 2" && node ./src/cli.js --mock --eval "await mcp.call('math.add', { a: 20, b: 22 })" && node ./src/cli.js --mock --file ./examples/mock-demo.js && node ./src/cli.js --config ./examples/multi-mock-repl.json --eval "await mcp.mock_a.eval({ code: 'await mcp.call(\"math.add\", { a: 20, b: 22 })' })"
